global.text:
GLOBAL (UI pass 2: reference UI)
• Header floats transparent over the hero, then turns birch + blur after 60px of scroll. Desktop: Home · About us · Shop | else lockup centred | Contact us + Get involved outline pill. Tablet/mobile: centred lockup + MENU.
• MENU opens a full-screen pine overlay: big Literata links stagger up, X draws in. Tweaks › previewMenu shows it on desktop.
• Logo: 'else' in Fraunces (soft, slightly wonky) + spaced MATERIAL LAB. Temporary until a real logo exists.
• Buttons: on hover they fill and a small arrow slides in from the left (reference behaviour).
• Cursor: thin sunrise ring that trails the pointer and grows over links. Desktop pointer only; off for reduced motion.
• Chapter rail shows from 1280px up.
• The hand-drawn 'carry forward' underline draws in on view, wherever it appears.
• Reduced motion: nothing pins or moves; every sequence shows complete.
• Tweaks: 'Coming soon' card state, chapter rail, menu preview.

hero.text:
HERO
• White background, text only for now. The hero animation comes later.
• The sea sits along the bottom; its waves roll sideways on their own.
• On scroll the water rises faster than the page moves, so it swallows the hero and becomes the blue of chapter 01 (works in Play / full view).
• Scroll badge fades on first scroll.

edges.text:
SECTION JOINS (no hard cuts, like the reference)
• Hero → 01: the rising sea.
• 01 → 02: mist rolls in (the reference's steam whiteout).
• 02 → 03 → donkey: soft hills.
• Donkey → founder and Join → footer: tree-line silhouette (our version of the reference's dark wood beam).
• Founder → Join: mist rises out of the dark.
• Mist layers drift slowly on their own.

why.text:
CH 01
• Contradiction line: steps reveal 1 → 2 → 3, step 3 turns ember.
• Text sequence is scroll-driven, not timed: the box pins, and each scroll step brings in the next block (4 steps). Each block then plays its own animation (lines fade up, text types), so readers can wait for it or keep scrolling. Scrolling back shows earlier steps complete. 'Scroll to continue' appears once a step has finished.
• Steps: contradiction → 'Not because…' types → three 'How…' lines one by one → conclusion as three separate typed sentences.
• Origin icons: thick, slightly irregular ink lines in forest green only. Lines draw in once, then loop: eye blinks, looks around and the focus arcs close in; hand lifts the crumpled plastic; the plastic slowly disperses into fragments; a long-haired profile thinks and a '?' appears.

what.text:
CH 02
• Lab loop: a fragment dot travels the ring clockwise through the 4 stages; each node can light up as the dot passes.
• Pivot band: 'awareness' underline draws in.
• Lens line: static text, no typing. Only the circle around 'Plastic' floats and drifts gently.

beliefs.text:
CH 03
• Two layouts, switch in Tweaks › Beliefs layout:
  – Staggered (new): 01 wide + 02 tall, bottoms aligned; 03 tall + 04 wide, tops aligned. Community is now 03, Waste is now 04.
  – Columns (previous).
• Tall cards are shorter now; the 'buy, use…' and 'gathering, making…' lists read as one sentence with accented words.
• Donkey: its own full-width white band, no box. Left = intro to 'often underestimated'; centre = square illustration; right = culture + values. One body size throughout; only the heading and eyebrow are larger.

founder.text:
CH 04
• Portrait + question index stay sticky; index = progress, click jumps.
• Questions sit on light labels. Answers keep one size; emphasis comes from bold, Literata italic and honey.
• 'Read the full conversation' expands the originals in place (works in Play).

join.text:
CH 05
• Cards lead with a square product photo; Coming soon tag sits over the image, top right.
• Hover: card lifts, photo zooms slightly, arrow slides in.
• Closing line types itself out (Typewriter component), then holds.
• Footer: honey lockup + 3-line blurb (reference layout), newsletter, all socials (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn) as circles that brighten on hover.
